column9: Peated Select Cask line uses imported Islay and Aberdeen peat, distinct from the unpeated core range (Brilliance/Edited/Nirvana/Classic)
officially branded 'Blackpitts Peated Single Malt' on teelingwhiskey.com; exact ppm not stated, heavy is a judgment call given it is marketed as the house's dedicated peated expression
Wikipedia: 'Smokey Monkey Batch 9, a blend that includes Islay whiskies' - medium rather than heavy since Islay malt is blended with the usual unpeated Speyside malts, not the whole content
2013 limited series explicitly named 'Heavily Peated', distinct from the core range (see producer.tsv note, peatProfile=light there)
